title: Add static animation cost model
summary: Added a pure pre-render animation cost model for tokens, simultaneous moving groups, fragments, shadows, and 3D layers; evaluates full, balanced, and efficient profiles; recommends a lower surface tier without changing semantic work; requests explicit pedagogical compression when all faithful tiers exceed budget; rejects malformed and hard-limit plans with actionable diagnostics; uses no browser geometry or runtime timing.
